content: I was invited to serve on the Program Committee of The 1st International Workshop on Embodied AI Quality and Safety (EQualS 2027), co-located with the ACM International Conference on the Foundations of Software Engineering (FSE 2027; CCF A). The main conference will take place in Shenzhen, China, on 12–16 July 2027.

Our paper "LLMCFG-TGen: Using LLM-Generated Control Flow Graphs to Automatically Create Test Cases from Use Cases" has been accepted by ACM Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology (TOSEM; JCR Q1, CCF A).
Our RCR report paper "LRASGen: LLM-based RESTful API Specification Generation — RCR Report" has been accepted by ACM Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology (TOSEM; JCR Q1, CCF A).
I started as a Postdoctoral Scholar in the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering at the University of Alberta, working with Prof. Lei Ma and Prof. Xingyu Li.
Our paper "LSem2Vec: A Simple yet Effective Two-Stage Approach for Source Code Embedding" has been accepted by Frontiers of Computer Science (FCS; JCR Q1, CCF B).
I joined Zhejiang Tonghuashun Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. as an Algorithm Engineer, working on Financial Agent foundation-model post-training and evaluation.
I received my Ph.D. in Computer Technology and Application from Macau University of Science and Technology.
Our paper "LRASGen: LLM-based RESTful API Specification Generation" has been accepted by ACM Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology (TOSEM; JCR Q1, CCF A).

Our RCR report paper "Large Language Models for Automated Web-Form-Test Generation: An Empirical Study — RCR Report" has been accepted by ACM Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology (TOSEM; JCR Q1, CCF A).
Our paper "A Novel Vision-based Approach to Test Sequence Generation for Mobile GUI Testing" has been accepted by IEEE Transactions on Reliability (TR; JCR Q1, CCF C).

Our paper "Toward Cost-effective Adaptive Random Testing: An Approximate Nearest Neighbor Approach", published in IEEE Transactions on Software Engineering (TSE; JCR Q1, CCF A), has been accepted for presentation in the Journal-First Track of the 40th IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE 2025; CCF A).

Our paper "Large Language Models for Automated Web-Form-Test Generation: An Empirical Study", published in ACM Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology (TOSEM; JCR Q1, CCF A), has been accepted for presentation in the Journal-First Track of the 40th IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE 2025; CCF A).
Our paper "Adaptive Random Testing of Deep Learning Systems Using Image Hashing" has been accepted by IEEE Transactions on Reliability (TR; JCR Q1, CCF C).
Our paper "Ribonucleic-Acid Protein Interaction Prediction Based on Deep Learning: A Comprehensive Survey" has been accepted by Applied Soft Computing (JCR Q1, unlisted in the CCF A/B/C directory).
Our paper "Large Language Models for Automated Web-Form-Test Generation: An Empirical Study" has been accepted by ACM Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology (TOSEM; JCR Q1, CCF A).
